purpose: Deterministic static fixture definitions for bounded Canvas/WebGL Viewer evaluation. This corpus is not a runtime benchmark result or a default-renderer decision.

measurementContract.crossDevice: A result must identify a genuinely distinct device. Multiple browsers or viewport sizes on one host are not cross-device evidence.

limitations: The corpus generates static source only; it does not execute target code.
A measured renderer construction is a local observation, not a performance promise or a default-renderer approval.
Canvas remains the supported default until all renderer, human-review, and cross-device requirements are met.
